verdict.rationale: Linear is a product-planning tool, so shipping release-note communication is a fair question for it. However, the evidence shows no capability to compose or send release announcements segmented by user attributes. Customer attributes such as tier, revenue and size are used only to filter issues and projects. That is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can segment product release announcements by user attributes to send targeted release notes
